submitted.rationale: Out of 5 EQE measurements, Sb=0.31 (index 4) gave the highest EQE, 0.0242%. Its neighbours were lower: 0.0140% at Sb=0.20 and 0.0189% at Sb=0.365. So the peak is near Sb≈0.3. In XRD, index 4 is a single phase that looks like pyrochlore. Index 0, at the Pb-rich end, shows extra peaks from an unmatched second phase.

rejected.reason: Sb 0.51, the Pb2Sb2O7 stoichiometric composition, gave only 0.0096% EQE
Sb 0.68, the PbSb2O6 region, gave 0.0079% EQE, the lowest measured
